cuts.voiceover_text: Rick just realized these alien captors made one fatal mistake: they dragged Morty into their trap. The Zigerians are desperate to steal his secret dark matter formula. Rick is furious. Instead of running, he plots revenge to scam the scammers and rob them completely blind.

To break the system, Rick stages a massive rap concert. He baits the listening aliens by promising his secret dark matter recipe is hidden inside the lyrics. The trap works instantly. Rick grabs the microphone and hypes the simulated crowd into a frenzy. He orders every single person to jump up and down together. Hundreds of bodies leap into the air at once. The simulation cannot handle the sudden processing load. The entire virtual world glitches, stutters, and freezes completely solid.

With the environment frozen, the virtual treadmill stops rendering new terrain. Rick sprints toward the edge of the holographic grid with Morty right behind him. They dive headfirst over the simulation boundary and tumble straight into the real alien mothership.

Rick raids the ship's processor vault, fills their arms with alien tech, and hijacks a getaway cruiser. As they blast into space, Rick laughs that he outsmarted the scammers and escaped clean. But did they really make it out... or is this just another simulation?

series.summary: Rick exploits the simulation's glitches, overloads the CPU with a chaotic rap concert, and escapes the chamber with Morty to raid the mothership.
